sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: I Am Speed - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I hate it when fighters just sit in corners like scared little rats. Long pauses are a disgusting, exhausting sight for the audience. Show me a slaughter! Speed! Adrenaline! Only speed will flush those rats out of their holes!"

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:

- Ref Rep +0.02
- 88,200 Roubles
- 40 GP coins
- 1× Supply crate (Rare)
